claim_boundary.purpose: Disambiguate the original frozen temporal allocation provenance from the later whole-cohort diagnostic allocation, and record the diagnostic q-level support limitation.

authoritative_fields.registration.allocation_rule: For an observed event with baseline duration T, the registered 2% starting event-time budget is 0.02*T; the registered save/integration share cap allocates at most 0.20*(0.02*T)=0.004*T to save/integration sensitivity.
authoritative_fields.registration.allocation_status: The absolute per-event allocations below are derived from the registered generic contract and are diagnostic accounting, not an automatic Q-N threshold.

diagnostic_only_fields.q_level_status: new diagnostic registration for this whole-cohort comparison; not part of the original frozen gate

whole_cohort_report.report_semantics: The report is a CPU diagnostic over consumed HALF/QUARTER labels. It does not alter the original budget or grant Q-N.

allocation_provenance.frozen_authority: Use the original_frozen_budget event_allocations values for any frozen-gate accounting. Never recompute these values from a native observed velocity, a later temporal variant, or a changed comparison cohort.
allocation_provenance.new_values_are_descriptive_only: The values in the report's observed_event_integration_allocation are an additive diagnostic normalization using the actual HALF observed chord feature time. They are not replacements for the frozen allocations.

events.verdict: no_observed_feature_time; retain right-censoring and do not infer physical exit

allocation_provenance.interpretation: Both allocation conventions give the same negative temporal result. This sidecar records the provenance correction; it does not relax the budget or convert the result into Q-N.

q_level_provenance_and_support.registration_status: new diagnostic q-level convention introduced by whole_cohort_quantiles_v1; not originally pre-registered as the initial gate
q_level_provenance_and_support.cohort_semantics: Mass-weighted whole initial fluid cohort. Observed first passage is conditional; identities without observed passage remain right-censored at the 10 s window; unresolved native support is [0,+inf].

observed_support.q_0_5_and_q_0_9: upper support remains unbounded because censoring exceeds the observed cohort support

observed_support.support_statement: Only about 5.2% of the canonical initial mass has an observed y-axis crossing in HALF; q=.1, .5, and .9 whole-cohort bounds are unresolved by right-censoring.
observed_support.interpretation: The q-levels cannot identify a physical-vs-censoring explanation from this support. Do not label the unidentified result as a waveform-model error.

observed_support.support_statement: The quarter result observes about 5.6%; this does not repair the whole-cohort identification gap.
All identities remain censored; no physical exit is inferred.

q_level_provenance_and_support.operator_gap: The consumed HALF/QUARTER operator comparison reports conditional observed means/brackets, whereas these q-levels are whole-cohort censor-safe bounds. They are different estimands.
q_level_provenance_and_support.negative_interpretation_rule: unidentified_due_to_censoring is a support limitation, not evidence of a waveform-model error or a physical spill event

reproducibility.calculation_policy: Preserve the original frozen allocations verbatim and compare the same observed delta to both provenance values only as an audit. Do not derive a new frozen scale from observed speed, native step, or a new variant.
